# streamed reply
/agent praw
hello there
/expect \[praw\] reply from
# delegation with turn summary (BRAINSTORM_TURN_LIMIT=1)
/delegate fahsai write the report
/wait-idle 30
/expect (?s)HR-0001.*thread \d+ fahsai\] reply from.*Reason: turn_limit
# approval request, refused for user, approved by admin, wake reply printed
NEEDAPPROVAL please
/expect \[approval [0-9a-f-]{36}\] Use tool X
/as user
/approve last
/expect not_approver
/as admin
/approve last
/expect approved decided_by=cli:admin
/wait-idle 30
/expect \[praw\] Thanks, approval received
/quit
